resumo: 4 REPROVA, resto LIBERA. Lote so libera apos corrigir as 4.

itens.texto: Our ___ changes with where we look from.
itens.lastro: S7/roteiro P1: perspective changes depending on where we look from. Frase equivalente, verdadeira.

itens.texto: Seen from the ___, we look up.
itens.contraexemplo: 'Seen from the perspective' e agramatical sem 'a/this'; resolve por eliminacao.
itens.correcao: opcional: manter 'at it' ('we look up at it')

itens.texto: Not right or wrong: just a ___ view.
itens.contraexemplo: 'just a bottom view' e 'just a perspective view' sao frases validas (view-bottom existe no proprio material); sem 'of things' e sem sujeito a lacuna aceita 3 opcoes.
itens.correcao: They are not right or wrong. They just have a ___ view of things. (citacao do material, sujeito de volta)

itens.onde: On the test, perspectiva, 3o item (fig view-giraffe)
itens.texto: Not right or wrong: just a different ___. (resp view)
itens.contraexemplo: 'just a different perspective' e verdadeira, ate mais idiomatica, e a licao ensina 'perspective'; a versao antiga tinha 'different ___ of things' que travava em view.
itens.correcao: People are not right or wrong. They just have a different ___ of things. (view) ; ou aceitar view e perspective como respostas; ou dar a inicial v___.

itens.texto: The ___ is the way we are going.
itens.lastro: roteiro D2: 'the path (way) we are going'; map-school.
itens.contraexemplo: left/right cabem gramaticalmente ('the left is the way we are going') mas estao ocupados nas lacunas k1/k2 e o par 'path' e o unico com sentido de caminho; risco baixo.
itens.correcao: opcional p/ blindar: The path is the way we are going. (trocar a lacuna por 'The ___ is the way we are going' so se as opcoes left/right nao entrarem no mesmo arrasta)

itens.onde: arrasta mapa k4 / teoria mapa / test item
itens.texto: We might get ___ if we run. / We might get lost if we run. / True or false: we might get lost if we run.
itens.lastro: roteiro D3: 'We might get lost if we run or don't pay attention'. Cortar 'or don't pay attention' nao falsifica; so 'between/left/right/path' nao cabem em 'get ___'.

itens.texto: Pay attention to the details and to the path.
itens.lastro: roteiro D2 (sem o contexto 'when we read maps', que a tela do mapa fornece).
itens.correcao: opcional: reinserir 'When we read maps,' no inicio

itens.texto: We see things from different positions. Our perspective changes with where we look from.
They look from different positions. Not right or wrong: just a different view.
itens.lastro: S7/P4 (girafa), resumo fiel; na teoria nao ha lacuna, entao nao ha duas respostas.

itens.texto: ___: up and down after hitting a surface. / ___: through the air. / ___: turning over and over. / ___: smoothly along a surface. / ___: around and around. / ___: back and forth like a pendulum.
itens.lastro: S5/O1-O6, mesmas definicoes sem 'to move'. Resolvem por elimiacao com as 6 opcoes; as ambiguidades fly/spin/swing e roll/slide ja existiam na versao longa.
itens.contraexemplo: 'through the air' tambem serve a spin/swing; 'smoothly along a surface' a roll. Nao e nova.
itens.correcao: opcional: voltar 'to move' ('___: to move through the air.') para ficar frase de definicao e nao fragmento

itens.texto: To ___: up and down after hitting a surface. (bounce)
itens.lastro: S5/O1; 'after hitting a surface' so cabe a bounce.

itens.texto: Wind and water are natural forces. They can be helpful and harmful to us.
itens.lastro: S8/N1; nao afirma que sao as unicas.

itens.texto: A push or a pull can make things move.
itens.lastro: V2/F5 sem 'from one place to another'; verdadeira.

itens.texto: Push and pull are opposite forces.
the rope of a kite / picking fruit and vegetables
itens.lastro: V2/F7. Nota: 'the rope of a kite' deixou de ser acao; coerente com 'a shopping trolley' do Push.
itens.correcao: opcional: 'pulling the rope of a kite'

itens.texto: Movements of your body? (resp: swim, climb, play, walk, pick, sit)
itens.contraexemplo: Sem 'Make a list', pergunta de resposta fechada: 'run, jump, dance, eat' tambem sao movimentos do corpo e a crianca estaria 'errada'. Pergunta fragmento tambem fica ambigua.
itens.correcao: Name movements of your body (from the slide). / Dê movimentos do corpo (do slide): swim, climb, play, walk, pick, sit. Idem para a mao (touch, lift, point, write, grab, push).

itens.texto: Look at the picture. Where is the fish? (resp: inside the bowl)
itens.lastro: S3/A12, prep-inside; aberta, 'in the bowl' tambem e correta.
